text.title: Junior Next Pr Checklist Template Procedure
text.summary: Seven steps from a completed review to a checklist the junior pastes into their next PR: reconcile the previous checklist (retire, escalate, carry), harvest candidate items from review comments with permalinks, phrase each as a yes/no check, route machine-checkable items to lint, cite the standard and set severity with one blocker, cut to 3 to 7 with a deferred list, then hand the draft to the mentor who confirms it before the junior receives it. Each step names the rule it satisfies and the fields of `02-output-contract.xml` it fills.

step.name: reconcile-the-previous-checklist
step.input: The previous checklist as pasted in the just-reviewed PR's description; its tick state.
step.action: Record `previous_checklist_url`. For each previous item: ticked on this PR and the one before it, move to `retired` with `consecutive_prs_ticked`; unmet for the third time, move to `pairing_sessions` with a date; unmet once or twice, carry it forward with `status = carried` and `carried_count`; ticked once, keep it as `carried` (r-carry-forward-and-retire).
step.decision-gate: The previous checklist was not pasted or the ticks were not the junior's: the review is sent back before code is read (r-junior-self-ticks-before-review); this procedure resumes after the junior ticks.

step.name: harvest-candidates-with-permalinks
step.input: Every review comment and diff-line comment on `source_pr.url`.
step.action: For each substantive comment (not a nit a formatter would catch) create a candidate with its permalink into the PR. A candidate with no comment behind it is dropped, however good the advice (r-item-traces-to-review-comment).

step.name: phrase-each-as-a-yes-no-check
step.action: Rewrite each candidate as a check a reviewer answers yes or no on the next PR ("every new public function has a docstring"). Remove trait phrasing: "be more careful", "think about", "try to", "cleaner code" (r-item-is-verifiable-on-next-pr).
step.decision-gate: A candidate that cannot be phrased as an observable check on the next PR is not a checklist item; it is a conversation, and is noted for the 1:1 instead.

step.name: route-machine-checkable-items-to-lint
step.input: Each check; the repository's linter, formatter, type-checker and CI configuration.
step.action: Where a rule can enforce the check, set `lint.machine_enforceable`, name the `rule` and file the `automation_ticket` or PR that enables it; the item stays for at most one PR after the automation lands (r-machine-checkable-items-become-lint).

step.name: cite-the-standard-and-set-severity
step.input: The team's style guide, ADRs and CONTRIBUTING.md.
step.action: For each item cite the section, ADR or anchor it enforces; with no written standard label it `preference:<mentor-handle>`. Order by severity and label `blocking` or `should`; at most one item is `blocking`, and a preference can never be (r-item-cites-team-standard, r-severity-ordered-one-blocker).
step.decision-gate: Two candidates compete for `blocking`: the one with the written standard wins; the other becomes `should`.

step.name: cut-to-three-to-seven-and-defer-the-rest
step.action: Keep 3 to 7 items, highest severity first; move the remaining candidates with their permalinks to `deferred`, to be promoted only when an item is retired (r-three-to-seven-items). Fill `templates/output.md.j2` in the form the junior will paste.

step.name: hand-the-draft-to-the-mentor
step.action: Validate with `--file`, set `review.status = ready_for_mentor_review`. The mentor confirms every permalink and severity label and records the date; only then does the mentor, not the agent, hand the checklist to the junior (human checkpoint in `03-failure-modes.xml`).
step.decision-gate: Mentor has not confirmed: the checklist is not given to the junior and the next PR is not gated on it.

list.item: 3 to 7 items, each with a permalink into the source PR, phrased as a yes/no check, citing a standard or labelled as a preference.
At most one `blocking` item, never a preference; machine-enforceable items name their rule and ticket.
Retired, carried and pairing-session items reconciled against the previous checklist; deferred candidates kept with permalinks.
Posting rule recorded: the junior pastes and ticks, the mentor verifies; the mentor has confirmed before the junior receives it.
